assumptions_metadata.task_description: Power a streaming service’s catalog ranking and parental-control pipeline by computing popularity scores and filtering content using IMDb metadata.

import argparse
import os
import re
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Normalize types used by downstream logic
    df['IMDB_Rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['Released_Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Released_Year'], errors='coerce')
    df['No_of_Votes'] = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce')
    df['Meta_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Meta_score'], errors='coerce')
    df['Runtime'] = df['Runtime'].astype(str)
    df['Series_Title'] = df['Series_Title'].astype(str)
    df['Genre'] = df['Genre'].astype(str)
    df['Poster_Link'] = df['Poster_Link'].astype(str)
    # Certificate can be missing; keep as object

    current_year = datetime.utcnow().year

    # Validate title-year identity and bounds before indexing and ranking stability
    # ASSERTION_START
    title_len = df['Series_Title'].str.len()
    assert df['Series_Title'].notna().all()
    assert ((title_len >= 1) & (title_len <= 200)).all()
    assert df['Released_Year'].notna().all()
    assert ((df['Released_Year'] >= 1900) & (df['Released_Year'] <= current_year)).all()
    assert df.duplicated(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).sum() == 0
    # ASSERTION_END

    df.set_index(['Series_Title', 'Released_Year'], inplace=True, drop=False)

    # Validate IMDB rating before computing normalized and bucketized scores
    r = df['IMDB_Rating']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert r.notna().all()
    assert ((r >= 0.0) & (r <= 10.0)).all()
    assert np.isclose(r * 10, np.round(r * 10)).all()
    assert (((r >= 7.0) & (r <= 9.5)).mean() >= 0.90)
    # ASSERTION_END

    rating_bin = (df['IMDB_Rating'] * 10).astype(int)

    # Validate votes before Bayesian weighting and exposure boosts
    v = df['No_of_Votes']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert v.notna().all()
    assert np.isfinite(v).all()
    assert (np.isclose(v, np.floor(v))).all()
    assert (v >= 0).all()
    assert (v <= 10_000_000).all()
    assert ((v >= 10_000).mean() >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Validate runtime before engagement penalty
    runtime_str = df['Runtime']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert runtime_str.str.match(r'^[0-9]+ min$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    minutes = runtime_str.str.extract(r'([0-9]+)', expand=False).astype(int)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((minutes >= 45) & (minutes <= 240)).all()
    assert (((minutes >= 80) & (minutes <= 180)).mean() >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['runtime_min'] = minutes

    # Certificate and genre validation before parental-control filtering
    allowed_certs = {
        'U','UA','A','G','PG','PG-13','R','NC-17','Not Rated','Approved','Passed',
        'TV-MA','TV-14','TV-PG','12A','15','18'
    }
    allowed_genres = {
        'Action','Adventure','Animation','Biography','Comedy','Crime','Drama','Family','Fantasy',
        'History','Horror','Music','Musical','Mystery','Romance','Sci-Fi','Sport','Thriller',
        'War','Western','Film-Noir'
    }

    cert = df['Certificate']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (cert.notna().mean() >= 0.85)
    assert cert[cert.notna()].isin(allowed_certs).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    genre_tokens = df['Genre'].str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: 1 <= len(xs) <= 3).all()
    assert genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: all([t in allowed_genres for t in xs])).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    ug_mask = cert.isin({'U', 'G'})
    conflict = ug_mask & df['Genre'].str.contains(r'\b(Horror|Thriller)\b', case=False, na=False)
    assert (~conflict).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Meta score validation before blending into ranking model
    ms = df['Meta_score']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (ms.notna().mean() >= 0.80)
    present = ms.notna() & r.notna()
    assert ((ms[ms.notna()] >= 0) & (ms[ms.notna()] <= 100)).all()
    pairs = df.loc[present, ['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
    corr = pairs['IMDB_Rating'].corr(pairs['Meta_score'])
    assert pd.notna(corr) and (corr >= 0.3)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Gross parsing and validation before revenue-based boost
    gross_ser = df['Gross']
    present_mask = gross_ser.notna() & (gross_ser.astype(str).str.lower() != 'nan')
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert present_mask.mean() >= 0.80
    assert gross_ser[present_mask].astype(str).str.match(r'^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    gross_usd = pd.Series(np.where(present_mask, gross_ser.astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), np.nan), index=df.index)
    gross_usd = pd.to_numeric(gross_usd, errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((gross_usd[present_mask] >= 0) & (gross_usd[present_mask] <= 3_000_000_000)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['gross_usd'] = gross_usd.fillna(0)

    # Poster link validation before emitting assets into downstream catalog
    links = df['Poster_Link']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert links.str.startswith('https://').all()
    assert links.str.lower().str.endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg')).all()
    assert (links.nunique(dropna=False) / len(links)) >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Popularity scoring model
    C = r.mean()
    m_const = 20_000.0
    weight = v / (v + m_const)
    bayes = weight * r + (1 - weight) * C
    wr_norm = bayes / 10.0
    meta_norm = ms.fillna(ms.mean()) / 100.0
    votes_boost = np.log1p(v) / np.log(10_000_000 + 1)
    runtime_penalty = np.exp(-((df['runtime_min'] - 110.0) ** 2) / (2 * (30.0 ** 2)))
    rev_boost = np.log1p(df['gross_usd']) / np.log(3_000_000_000 + 1)

    base_quality = 0.7 * wr_norm + 0.3 * meta_norm
    popularity = base_quality * (0.2 + 0.8 * votes_boost) * (0.2 + 0.8 * runtime_penalty) + 0.05 * rev_boost
    popularity = popularity + (rating_bin * 1e-6)

    df['popularity'] = popularity
    df['global_rank'] = df['popularity'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

    # Primary genre for genre-level ranking downstream
    df['primary_genre'] = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: xs[0] if len(xs) > 0 else np.nan)

    # Parental-control filtered catalog (kids tier)
    kids_allowed_certs = {'U', 'G', 'PG'}
    kids_mask = df['Certificate'].isin(kids_allowed_certs) & (~df['Genre'].str.contains(r'\b(Horror|Thriller)\b', case=False, na=False))
    kids_catalog = df.loc[kids_mask].copy()
    kids_catalog['rank_kids'] = kids_catalog['popularity'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

    # Per-genre top 10
    genre_top10 = (
        df.sort_values(['primary_genre', 'popularity'], ascending=[True, False])
          .groupby('primary_genre', group_keys=False)
          .head(10)
          .copy()
    )
    genre_top10['rank_within_genre'] = genre_top10.groupby('primary_genre')['popularity'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

    # Write outputs
    ranking_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'Genre', 'IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score',
        'No_of_Votes', 'runtime_min', 'gross_usd', 'Poster_Link', 'popularity', 'global_rank'
    ]
    df.sort_values('global_rank')[ranking_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'catalog_ranking.csv'), index=False)

    kids_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'Genre', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes',
        'runtime_min', 'Poster_Link', 'popularity', 'rank_kids'
    ]
    kids_catalog.sort_values('rank_kids')[kids_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'kids_catalog.csv'), index=False)

    genre_cols = [
        'primary_genre', 'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes',
        'popularity', 'rank_within_genre'
    ]
    genre_top10.sort_values(['primary_genre', 'rank_within_genre'])[genre_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'top10_by_genre.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    assert runtime_str.str.match(r'^[0-9]+ min$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    minutes = runtime_str.str.extract(r'([0-9]+)', expand=False).astype(int)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((minutes >= 45) & (minutes <= 240)).all()
    assert (((minutes >= 80) & (minutes <= 180)).mean() >= 0.95)
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['runtime_min'] = minutes

    # Certificate and genre validation before parental-control filtering
    allowed_certs = {
        'U','UA','A','G','PG','PG-13','R','NC-17','Not Rated','Approved','Passed',
        'TV-MA','TV-14','TV-PG','12A','15','18'
    }
    allowed_genres = {
        'Action','Adventure','Animation','Biography','Comedy','Crime','Drama','Family','Fantasy',
        'History','Horror','Music','Musical','Mystery','Romance','Sci-Fi','Sport','Thriller',
        'War','Western','Film-Noir'
    }

    cert = df['Certificate']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (cert.notna().mean() >= 0.85)
    assert cert[cert.notna()].isin(allowed_certs).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    genre_tokens = df['Genre'].str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: 1 <= len(xs) <= 3).all()
    assert genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: all([t in allowed_genres for t in xs])).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    ug_mask = cert.isin({'U', 'G'})
    conflict = ug_mask & df['Genre'].str.contains(r'\b(Horror|Thriller)\b', case=False, na=False)
    assert (~conflict).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Meta score validation before blending into ranking model
    ms = df['Meta_score']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert (ms.notna().mean() >= 0.80)
    present = ms.notna() & r.notna()
    assert ((ms[ms.notna()] >= 0) & (ms[ms.notna()] <= 100)).all()
    pairs = df.loc[present, ['IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score']].dropna()
    corr = pairs['IMDB_Rating'].corr(pairs['Meta_score'])
    assert pd.notna(corr) and (corr >= 0.3)
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Gross parsing and validation before revenue-based boost
    gross_ser = df['Gross']
    present_mask = gross_ser.notna() & (gross_ser.astype(str).str.lower() != 'nan')
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert present_mask.mean() >= 0.80
    assert gross_ser[present_mask].astype(str).str.match(r'^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    gross_usd = pd.Series(np.where(present_mask, gross_ser.astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), np.nan), index=df.index)
    gross_usd = pd.to_numeric(gross_usd, errors='coerce')

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((gross_usd[present_mask] >= 0) & (gross_usd[present_mask] <= 3_000_000_000)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['gross_usd'] = gross_usd.fillna(0)

    # Poster link validation before emitting assets into downstream catalog
    links = df['Poster_Link']
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert links.str.startswith('https://').all()
    assert links.str.lower().str.endswith(('.jpg', '.jpeg')).all()
    assert (links.nunique(dropna=False) / len(links)) >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Popularity scoring model
    C = r.mean()
    m_const = 20_000.0
    weight = v / (v + m_const)
    bayes = weight * r + (1 - weight) * C
    wr_norm = bayes / 10.0
    meta_norm = ms.fillna(ms.mean()) / 100.0
    votes_boost = np.log1p(v) / np.log(10_000_000 + 1)
    runtime_penalty = np.exp(-((df['runtime_min'] - 110.0) ** 2) / (2 * (30.0 ** 2)))
    rev_boost = np.log1p(df['gross_usd']) / np.log(3_000_000_000 + 1)

    base_quality = 0.7 * wr_norm + 0.3 * meta_norm
    popularity = base_quality * (0.2 + 0.8 * votes_boost) * (0.2 + 0.8 * runtime_penalty) + 0.05 * rev_boost
    popularity = popularity + (rating_bin * 1e-6)

    df['popularity'] = popularity
    df['global_rank'] = df['popularity'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

    # Primary genre for genre-level ranking downstream
    df['primary_genre'] = genre_tokens.apply(lambda xs: xs[0] if len(xs) > 0 else np.nan)

    # Parental-control filtered catalog (kids tier)
    kids_allowed_certs = {'U', 'G', 'PG'}
    kids_mask = df['Certificate'].isin(kids_allowed_certs) & (~df['Genre'].str.contains(r'\b(Horror|Thriller)\b', case=False, na=False))
    kids_catalog = df.loc[kids_mask].copy()
    kids_catalog['rank_kids'] = kids_catalog['popularity'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

    # Per-genre top 10
    genre_top10 = (
        df.sort_values(['primary_genre', 'popularity'], ascending=[True, False])
          .groupby('primary_genre', group_keys=False)
          .head(10)
          .copy()
    )
    genre_top10['rank_within_genre'] = genre_top10.groupby('primary_genre')['popularity'].rank(method='first', ascending=False).astype(int)

    # Write outputs
    ranking_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'Genre', 'IMDB_Rating', 'Meta_score',
        'No_of_Votes', 'runtime_min', 'gross_usd', 'Poster_Link', 'popularity', 'global_rank'
    ]
    df.sort_values('global_rank')[ranking_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'catalog_ranking.csv'), index=False)

    kids_cols = [
        'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'Genre', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes',
        'runtime_min', 'Poster_Link', 'popularity', 'rank_kids'
    ]
    kids_catalog.sort_values('rank_kids')[kids_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'kids_catalog.csv'), index=False)

    genre_cols = [
        'primary_genre', 'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'Certificate', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes',
        'popularity', 'rank_within_genre'
    ]
    genre_top10.sort_values(['primary_genre', 'rank_within_genre'])[genre_cols].to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'top10_by_genre.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
